overall.summary: TNC exhibits a clear and concerning pattern of disclosure degradation between its May 2025 and August 2025 10-Q filings. Specific dollar amounts ($12.4M ERP spend), concrete cash flow drivers, and substantive supply chain risk language were systematically replaced with a single boilerplate sentence about 'sustainable profitability.' The same generic language appears as a substitute across multiple filing sections, suggesting a deliberate effort to reduce transparency rather than routine editorial revision.
